title: AI pet adoption scams: Meta report | The Straits Times
summary: Meta reported a new pet adoption scam using generative AI to create fake adoption content and requests for upfront payments, targeting victims in multiple countries. The scam involves a network of 100 groups and 12,000 accounts on Facebook and Instagram, using AI for product descriptions, translations, and realistic animal images. Meta is investing in AI to detect and prevent such scams.
sentiment_reason: The article discusses a negative market impact due to the prevalence of sophisticated scams, which could erode user trust and potentially lead to financial losses for individuals and damage to Meta's brand reputation.
